original.target_description: Study 1 heart-rate analyses located on printed p.1579 (PDF p.5), continuing Heart rate from p.1577. Supplied p.4 is Figure 2 only. Description names emotion, anxiety and their interaction without choosing one of multiple omnibus and two-condition tests; no unique target can be selected.

replication.target_description: Unassigned side; not examined under original-only blind validation.

notes: Published seven-page article, Facing Freeze: Social Threat Induces Bodily Freeze in Humans, Roelofs, Hagenaars, and Stins (2010), DOI 10.1177/0956797610384746; first page and PDF pages 3–5 visually inspected. Original paper is available. Locator insufficiency concerns test selection, not source availability. Heart-rate section reports an emotion-only omnibus ANOVA; an emotion effect adjusted for state anxiety; an Emotion × Anxiety interaction; a happy-versus-angry emotion contrast; a happy-versus-angry Emotion × Anxiety interaction; and correlations with anxiety. The broad description and p.4 locator do not distinguish these. No statistic pair selected; all failure-side value fields are null.
